seo_home_title: EasyQuran · the Quran, made easy to read
seo_home_description: Read the Quran. Free, no ads, and fast — nothing in the way of the text.
nav_offline_detail: You are offline — cached content only.
footer_blurb: A free Qur'an reader — growing into hadith, audio, deeds and native apps.
tweaks_derived_colours: Surfaces, hairlines and text steps are derived from the background; the soft washes from the accent.
tweaks_performance_reload: Reloads the page to apply — Firebase Performance can only be switched at startup
surface_ink_note: Neutral near-black / paper white. The default.
surface_paper_note: Warm sepia — closest to a printed mushaf.
surface_mocha_note: Deep espresso browns, low glare at night.
surface_contrast_note: Pure black / pure white — maximum legibility.
landing_badge: Free forever · no ads · no account needed
landing_hero_title: The simplest way to read the Qur'an.
landing_hero_intro: Open it, read, close it. Search, bookmarks and recitation are there when you need them — invisible when you don't.
landing_today_title: Small on purpose. Fast where it matters.
landing_today_intro: Nothing between you and the text — here's what's already in the reader today.
landing_value_instant_body: Opens straight to the text — no install, no account, no setup.
landing_value_size_body: Scale the Arabic script until it sits comfortably for your eyes.
landing_value_free_body: No paywall, no ad tracking, and nothing you have to sign up for.
landing_value_authentic_body: Uthmani script — the same wording as the standard printed mushaf.
landing_roadmap_title: A reader now. A platform next.
landing_roadmap_intro: Today the reader holds the full 114 chapters — and the features below are on the way.
landing_roadmap_native_body: Desktop and mobile apps, so it feels at home on every device.
landing_roadmap_sync_body: An optional account carries your bookmarks, notes and last page wherever you read.
landing_roadmap_audio_body: Full audio recitation — for now the player is only a preview.
landing_roadmap_content_body: More to read beside the Qur'an, added carefully and each credited.
